edges: Rebekah Gregory was injured by the bombs planted by Dzhokhar Tsarnaev.
Dzhokhar Tsarnaev and Tamerlan Tsarnaev were involved in the Boston Marathon bombing.
Sean Collier was shot and killed by Dzhokhar Tsarnaev.
Richard Donohue was wounded in a shootout with Dzhokhar Tsarnaev.
Karen Brassard attended the trial to help her heal from the bombing.
Jeff Bauman became a symbol of resilience after the bombing.
